C1_hit.means: promoted input returns passed=True, matched=True, exact promoted output + artifact_hash

C2_miss.means: absent input returns passed=True, matched=False, output None, artifact_hash None

C3_failed_verification.note: passed=False match=None document=None entries=0 checks=[True, True, True, True, True, False]
C3_failed_verification.means: a suspended member returns passed=False, match is None, document None

C4_expected_hash_mismatch.means: a wrong expected_function_hash returns passed=False and match None

C5_empty_promoted_set.note: passed=True entries=0 matched=False output=None artifact_hash=None checks=[True, True, True, True, True, True]
C5_empty_promoted_set.means: a scope with no promoted set reports its verdict; note records passed + entries

C6_one_snapshot.note: transaction_calls=1 write_flags=[False] sql_statements=13 state_samples=15 in_transaction_all=True enter=True exit=True
C6_one_snapshot.means: exactly one read transaction opens per call; in_transaction holds across verification

C7_no_clock.means: a raising System._now leaves every resolve answer unchanged

C8_no_write.means: ledger sha256 + full iterdump are byte-identical across hit, miss and failed calls

C9_no_event_no_id.means: events() and every id-allocating counter are unchanged across all three states

C10_missing_ledger.note: IntegrityError: ledger file is missing or unreadable; ledger_exists_after=False
C10_missing_ledger.means: resolve against a deleted ledger raises and creates no file

C11_unregistered_operation.note: NotFoundError: operation is not registered in this partition
C11_unregistered_operation.means: note records the exact class + message for an unknown operation

C12_canonical_equivalent_input.means: key-reordered and equal-value inputs resolve to the same hit

C13_evaluate_outside_snapshot.means: evaluating the returned document after rollback equals evaluating inside

C14_document_none_gate.means: a failed verdict never reaches evaluate; the spy records zero calls

C15_concurrent_writer.means: a writer committing between two resolves changes only the second answer
